photos.c: Above: The 5¾ mile road race. Left to right - Stuart Barrett, Paul Williamson, John Flynn (obscured), Paul Pringle and Dave Davies.

Above: Tom Carter always had a thought for his fellow club-mates. As a way for the Club to say thank you to Jack Goswell for all his hard work in fund raising over the years, first running the football competition and then the "200 Club", Tom organised a little ceremony at Belgrave Hall where Jack was presented with a carriage clock by our 1993/94 President. Left to right: Trevor Williams, John Davies (hidden), Dave Davies, Alan Mead, the late Tom Carter and Jack Goswell

Bronze medals were won by this fine body of men, Belgrave's M60 team in the Surrey Veterans' Cross Country Championship on October 4th at Petersham, Richmond Park. Left to right: Frank Gander, Tony Stone, Gerald Collins, Derek Crookes, Dave Davies, Alan Lane and Charlie Henn.
